comments.author: @terraatlasofficial
comments.text: The Rhine Falls detail surprised me — Europe's most powerful waterfall carved out only 15,000 years ago, and over 50 medieval castles along the middle stretch. That's a trip I need to plan.

comments.author: @ChrisWibbeler
comments.text: I grew up in eltville on the Rhein near a castle that we would explore as kids, one year in the late 60‘s the river receded to record lows and we found an old rotten door that led us to stairs and eventually to a long lost torture chamber still intact with devices and chains, I’m 67 now and can still picture it, was a neat place to grow up.
